name: western-stars-fashion-fitness-collection
image_purpose: fashion-fitness lookbook collection and campaign board

prompt.project_info: Create a six-look fashion and fitness editorial collection featuring adult fictional models in distinct studio, summer, mirror-selfie, and athleisure settings.
prompt.main_subject: Six adult fictional women with original identities across six looks: an off-white glossy long-sleeve bodysuit with white sneakers in a gray studio and ghosting effect; a navy one-piece tank with white trim and rose-gold aviators crouched beside a disco ball on green chroma; a green lace-trim athleisure top with blue high-waisted leggings and silver bracelet in a dark-wood mirror selfie; a maroon glossy couture bodysuit in a gray gradient studio; a vibrant red one-piece with white piping holding a mirror ball against green paper; and a deep-purple camisole with matching leggings in a residential phone mirror selfie.
prompt.composition_elements: Collection board with six distinct frames, varied crouched, standing, split, mirror-selfie, and prop-holding poses, clear outfit and environment separation, coherent fashion-fitness editorial styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio light for the gray bodysuit look, direct natural sunlight for summer looks, neutral indoor light for mirror selfies, and clean controlled studio light for couture; glossy realistic fabric and natural shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: High-detail photorealistic editorial collection, realistic textiles and props, natural anatomy, varied aspect ratios as appropriate to each look, clean typography-free presentation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Fashion and fitness editorial collection of six adult fictional women with original identities: 1) off-white glossy long-sleeve bodysuit with white sneakers in a minimalist gray studio with ghosting and soft diffused light; 2) navy one-piece tank with white trim and rose-gold aviator sunglasses crouched beside a reflective disco ball on a green chroma background in direct sunlight; 3) green lace-trim athleisure top, blue high-waisted leggings and silver bracelet in an empty dark-oak room as a mirror selfie; 4) maroon glossy couture bodysuit against a neutral gray gradient; 5) vibrant red one-piece with white piping holding a large mirror ball against green paper with hard sunlight shadows; 6) deep-purple flared camisole and matching leggings with strawberry-blonde waves in a residential phone mirror selfie. High-fashion editorial, realistic materials, natural anatomy, polished contemporary fitness collection.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, minor or underage appearance, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed hands, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, signature
